[[Blast (enchantment)|Evil Blast 6]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Blast (enchantment)|Evil Blast 6]]:''' This weapon is a sinister implement of evil deeds, dealing 6d6 Evil damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Evil damage on a critical hit. This effect makes the weapon evil aligned.
Good characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
